en.title: View Registration Status
en.excerpt: How to monitor invoice status, verify participants, and download e-tickets on the Archer dashboard.
en.content:
Access Event History

All events that you have registered for can be seen via Dashboard > My Events. This page summarizes all your competition activities, both those that are just taking place and those that have already been completed.

Understanding Registration Status

There are several status stages that you need to pay attention to:

  • Pending: Registration has been recorded, but payment has not been made or has not been confirmed.
  • Paid: Payment has been received by the archeris.net system.
  • Verified: Your participation data has been checked and approved by the organizing committee.
  • Rejected: Registration rejected (usually due to category mismatch or invalid data).

Manage Invoices

If you need to see detailed cost details or change your payment method (as long as it has not expired), you can click on the invoice number listed on your registration list.

Download Ticket & QR Code

After your status becomes Verified, the button to download the E-Ticket will be active. This ticket contains a unique QR Code that you must show when checking in at the match location for the attendance process and equipment verification.

📱
Mobile Tips
You can save a screenshot of the QR Code on your cellphone to speed up the check-in process at the field if the internet connection at the match location is unstable.

id.title: Melihat Status Pendaftaran
id.excerpt: Cara memantau status invoice, verifikasi peserta, dan mengunduh tiket elektronik di dashboard Pemanah.
id.content:
Akses Riwayat Event

Semua event yang pernah Anda daftar dapat dilihat melalui Dashboard > My Events. Halaman ini merangkum seluruh aktivitas kompetisi Anda, baik yang baru akan berlangsung maupun yang sudah selesai.

Memahami Status Pendaftaran

Ada beberapa tahapan status yang perlu Anda perhatikan:

  • Pending: Pendaftaran sudah tercatat, namun pembayaran belum dilakukan atau belum terkonfirmasi.
  • Paid: Pembayaran telah diterima oleh sistem archeris.net.
  • Verified: Data kepesertaan Anda telah diperiksa dan disetujui oleh panitia penyelenggara.
  • Rejected: Pendaftaran ditolak (biasanya karena ketidaksesuaian kategori atau data tidak valid).

Mengelola Invoice

Jika Anda perlu melihat detail rincian biaya atau mengubah metode pembayaran (selama belum kadaluarsa), Anda dapat mengklik nomor invoice yang tertera pada daftar pendaftaran Anda.

Mengunduh Tiket & QR Code

Setelah status Anda menjadi Verified, tombol untuk mengunduh E-Ticket akan aktif. Tiket ini berisi QR Code unik yang wajib Anda tunjukkan saat check-in di lokasi pertandingan untuk proses absensi dan verifikasi peralatan.

📱
Tips Mobile
Anda dapat menyimpan screenshot QR Code di ponsel Anda untuk mempercepat proses check-in di lapangan jika koneksi internet di lokasi pertandingan tidak stabil.
